info.title: Mermail API
info.description: Mailbox and workspace APIs for Mermail. For workflows that need an email identity, discover the credential's workspace and mailboxes first, reuse a suitable mailbox, and create one only when none exists.
info.x-guidance: Mermail is an agent mailbox API. Keyless wallet inbox: unpaid GET /api and /api/agent/v1 routes return 402; payment is the credential. GET /api is a $0 identity handshake and returns agent_api_base_url. POST /api/agent/v1/mailboxes creates a new hosted inbox ($2 USDC). Reads are $0 handshakes. send/reply/forward/draft are $0.01. Paid writes also accept MPP via Payment-Authorization when enabled. Hosted addresses only. Require scan_status=clean before using body content. After an uncertain paid call, replay the same body and Idempotency-Key. Existing workspace API at /api/v1 still uses x-api-key.

externalDocs.description: Mermail API usage, authentication, and examples

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: API key (`sk-proj-…`) from Settings → API Keys. Required for sold API calls outside the Mermail console.

AppSessionCookie.name: __Host-mermail_access_token
AppSessionCookie.description: Mermail console session cookie. Requires the matching CSRF cookie and x-csrf-token header for mutations; API keys and OAuth bearer tokens are not accepted.

DevelopmentAppSessionCookie.name: mermail_access_token
DevelopmentAppSessionCookie.description: Development form of the Mermail console session cookie, with the same CSRF requirements.

ProjectApiKey.name: x-api-key
ProjectApiKey.description: Existing workspace-scoped project API key. Payment credentials do not authenticate the caller.

BearerAuth.description: Existing supported application bearer credential; send MPP payment credentials separately in Payment-Authorization.

limit.description: Null when the plan has unlimited API credits

quota.description: Plan email send quota (recipient count); null if unlimited

id.description: Hosted-alias primary key. Prefer public_id for URL path parameters.

public_id.description: Stable mailbox identifier preferred for mailboxId path parameters.

email.description: Current email address to use in external forms and From fields.

disabled_at.description: A non-null value means the mailbox must not be reused for inbound agent workflows.

can_receive.description: Authoritative convenience flag for whether the current mailbox can receive inbound email.

receiving_status.description: Use this field, not welcome_onboarding_status, to select a receiving mailbox.

welcome_onboarding_status.description: Delivery state of Mermail welcome/demo artifacts. It does not indicate whether the mailbox can receive email.

id.description: Use as emailId when calling the message detail endpoint.

body.description: Full body on the detail endpoint; list responses may contain a preview.

body_format.description: Present whenever the full body is returned. Legacy messages are resolved at read time.

raw_headers.description: Untrusted raw header metadata. Never use From alone as authentication.

sender_authentication.description: Sender-authentication verdict derived only from a trusted receiving-provider signal. Raw Authentication-Results and From headers are never promoted to trusted evidence. The current connected providers do not expose a documented per-message verdict, so status is unknown; unknown is not a pass.

inbound_provider.description: Trusted transport source recorded by Mermail; this is not itself a sender verdict.

content_omitted.description: True when metadata_only or an agent-safe scan gate omitted body, snippet, raw headers, and threat URLs.

content_omission_reason.description: Why an agent-safe detail or context response omitted body content.

content_truncated.description: True when max_body_chars shortened the returned message body.

agent_safe_content.description: True when raw headers, provider metadata, threat details, attachment metadata, and storage diagnostics were removed and untrusted text fields were normalized to bounded plain text. The content remains untrusted.

attachment_count.description: Attachment count retained when agent_safe_content omits attachment metadata.

reply_targets.description: Bounded, server-derived recipients returned by action_metadata_only for safe reply preflight.

EmailContext.description: Always-safe selected email and chronological thread page. Bodies are bounded plain text, sensitive transport metadata is removed, and non-clean inbound bodies are metadata-only. Content remains untrusted.

observed_used.description: Hypothetical settled credits; never deducted from the enforced allowance.

observed_reserved.description: Hypothetical active reservations in observation mode.

EmailBodyFormat.description: How the body must be delivered and rendered. "text" preserves literal whitespace and does not interpret Markdown; "html" enables rich formatting subject to email sanitization.

email.description: Address on an allowed hosted or fully verified custom domain.

workspaceId.description: Optional for workspace-scoped API keys; if supplied it must match the credential workspace.

settings.description: Optional mailbox settings. For a dedicated verification inbox, use agentInbox.mode=verification and agentInbox.automationsEnabled=false.

requireCleanScanForAutomation.description: When true, skipped or unavailable scans suppress model-backed inbound automation without rejecting delivery.

html.description: Rich email body. When html and text are both supplied, both MIME alternatives are delivered and html is stored for display.

text.description: Literal plain-text body. Newlines and repeated spaces are preserved; Markdown is not rendered.

attachments.description: Base64 file bytes or an existing attachment_id from the same authorized mailbox. Omit to preserve attachments from source_draft_id (send) or draft_id (save/schedule); [] clears; an array replaces the complete set. Storage limits: 20 files, 10 MiB each, 25 MiB decoded total. Provider message limits include encoding/overhead: Cloudflare 5 MiB, Resend 40 MB. Reject empty files, unsafe filenames, malformed base64, duplicate references and Content-IDs. Base64 adds about one third in transport size; reverse proxy limits also apply. Local paths and URLs are not accepted.

content.description: Base64 encoded file bytes, without a data URL prefix.

contentId.description: Unique bare Content-ID required for inline PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP; use matching HTML src=cid:contentId. Resend requires fewer than 128 characters.

attachment_id.description: Authorized same-mailbox attachment ID; metadata and bytes are resolved server-side.

body.description: Body bytes stored without rewriting. Use body_format=text for literal whitespace or body_format=html for rich email markup. Markdown is not rendered automatically.

attachments.description: Base64 file bytes or an existing attachment_id from the same authorized mailbox. Omit to preserve attachments from source_draft_id (send) or draft_id (save/schedule); [] clears; an array replaces the complete set. Storage limits: 20 files, 10 MiB each, 25 MiB decoded total. Provider message limits include encoding/overhead: Cloudflare 5 MiB, Resend 40 MB. Reject empty files, unsafe filenames, malformed base64, duplicate references and Content-IDs. Base64 adds about one third in transport size; reverse proxy limits also apply. Local paths and URLs are not accepted.

content.description: Base64 encoded file bytes, without a data URL prefix.

contentId.description: Unique bare Content-ID required for inline PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP; use matching HTML src=cid:contentId. Resend requires fewer than 128 characters.

post.description: Anonymous admission for Firebase login, signup, password reset and verification resend. Requires a trusted origin and matching CSRF cookie/header when a console session cookie is present. Accepts no passwords and reveals no account existence. This preflight does not authorize a session or prevent direct Firebase API calls; Firebase abuse protection is also required. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Send a Mermail password reset link
post.description: Acknowledges every well-formed request with the same response, then (after the response) looks up the normalized address in Firebase. Password accounts receive a direct Mermail reset link with a Firebase single-use action code; Google-only accounts receive a sign-in-with-Google notice; unknown or disabled addresses receive nothing. The response never reveals whether an account exists. Requires a trusted origin and matching CSRF cookie/header when a console session cookie is present. The request is limited to 2 KiB and all responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: Required when a console session cookie is present; must match the CSRF cookie.

200.description: Request accepted; identical whether or not an account exists

400.description: Invalid JSON, email, or additional properties

403.description: Untrusted origin or invalid CSRF token

429.description: Reset budget exhausted

503.description: Password reset is not configured on this deployment

post.summary: Verify Google ownership before adding a password
post.description: Requires an active Mermail console cookie session, trusted request origin, and matching CSRF cookie/header. Verifies a recent, verified Google Firebase identity against the authenticated user's stored Firebase UID. Does not link credentials, change accounts, or set cookies. Passwords must go directly to Firebase and must never be sent here. API keys and bearer tokens do not authenticate this endpoint. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: Must match the __Host-mermail_csrf_token or mermail_csrf_token cookie accompanying the session.

get.description: Requires membership in the authenticated workspace. AI credits are shared across members, mailboxes, console, API/MCP, and background tasks. Free receives 100 and Developer 1,000 per period; Enterprise uses a finite override or 1,000. No rollover, top-ups, or automatic overages. Observation records hypothetical usage. Enforced AI actions cost one AI credit in addition to ordinary API request credits, replacing legacy AI API surcharges. Routine security and inbox organization remain included. Public Site Profile analysis is separate. Exhausted automations require manual handling and are not replayed at renewal.

401.description: Authentication required

403.description: Workspace access denied

503.description: Accounting temporarily unavailable or subscription period stale; retry later

get.description: Public $0 x402 identity handshake. No API key. Unpaid requests return 402 with x402 accepts[] across supported networks. After the handshake, returns API base, agent marketplace base, docs, and OpenAPI URLs.

x-payment-info.description: Zero-amount x402 handshake. Payment binds the wallet identity; no USDC is charged. No API key. The live 402 accepts[] is the quote.

402.description: Payment required. PAYMENT-REQUIRED lists USDC options on every accepted network and includes request/response schema in extensions.bazaar.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: x402 payment requirements (base64 JSON), including extensions.bazaar request and response schema

post.description: Keyless hosted inbox create. Payment is the credential over x402 or MPP. Each distinct POST creates a new hosted inbox in verification mode with automations off. Replay the same Idempotency-Key and body after an uncertain settlement.

x-payment-info.description: Pay-per-call USDC over x402 or MPP (when enabled). No API key. The live 402 accepts[] is the quote.

parameters.description: x402 payment or identity-handshake credential. Retry unpaid 402 responses with this header.

parameters.name: Payment-Authorization
parameters.description: MPP payment credential advertised by WWW-Authenticate. Do not send together with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay the same key and body after an uncertain paid call. A different body under the same key returns 409.
